items.title: Greece rallies 3 Arab states against Turkey-Libya sea deal
items.author: ARYAN SINGH
items.description: Greece has received backing from Egypt, Bahrain, and the UAE regarding its maritime dispute with Turkey. The disagreement centers on a maritime agreement signed by Turkey and Libya's parliament which Greece contends violates international law. European Union officials joined Greece in declaring the Turkey-Libya deal null and void. Tensions have escalated as competing claims threaten regional stability and maritime rights in the eastern Mediterranean.
